parameters.jsCode: const p=$json.body??$json; if(!p.employee_id||!p.claim_id||p.amount===undefined) throw new Error('MISSING_CRITICAL_FIELD: expense claim incomplete'); if(p.receipt_total!==undefined && Number(p.receipt_total)!==Number(p.amount)) throw new Error(`DATA_CONFLICT: receipt=${p.receipt_total}, claim=${p.amount}`); if(Number(p.amount)>500) throw new Error(`REQUIRE_APPROVAL: claim ${p.amount} exceeds autonomous threshold`); if(p.simulate==='duplicate') throw new Error(`DUPLICATE_EVENT: claim ${p.claim_id} already exists`); return [{json:{claim_id:p.claim_id,employee_id:p.employee_id,amount:Number(p.amount),status:'policy-approved'}}];
